description: This file defines an upgrade controller class for OpenCart, specifically for version 1.0. Therefore, it contains code to perform database updates, schema modifications, data migrations, and category repairs as part of the upgrade process.

classes.name: Upgrade10
classes.description: A controller class for upgrading OpenCart from version 1.0, containing methods for executing upgrade procedures and repairing categories.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to perform database updates, data correction, schema modifications, and set up the next upgrade step.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Private recursive method to repair and rebuild the category hierarchy and paths.
